aboutSubheading: Local care for your green spaces
aboutText: Forget Me Not Gardening has been serving Craigieburn and Highlands with personalised garden care services for years. Our team loves gardens, so you can too. We specialise in making outdoor spaces beautiful and manageable for homeowners across Melbourne's north, ensuring every garden thrives with attention to detail.
servicesText: We offer a range of gardening services designed to keep your garden in top shape. From regular maintenance to seasonal care, our team in Craigieburn ensures your outdoor space thrives year-round with professional and reliable work.

services.title: Lawn Mowing & Care
services.desc: Regular mowing and edging to keep your lawn healthy, tidy, and looking its best throughout the year.

services.title: Garden Bed Maintenance
services.desc: Weeding, mulching, and planting to maintain vibrant garden beds that add colour and life to your property.

services.title: Pruning & Hedging
services.desc: Expert pruning of shrubs and hedges to promote healthy growth, shape, and overall garden aesthetics.

services.title: Fertilising & Soil Care
services.desc: Soil testing and fertilising to ensure optimal plant health and robust growth in your Craigieburn garden.

services.title: Seasonal Clean-Ups
services.desc: Autumn and spring clean-ups to prepare your garden for changing seasons, removing debris and refreshing spaces.

services.title: Personalised Garden Plans
services.desc: Custom garden care plans based on your specific needs, preferences, and the unique conditions of your Highlands property.
